svg.title: this explicitly recovers the radius absorption and convergent shell price used in the finite partition induction. No unchanged register is removed to obtain this estimate. For each fixed finite angular partition let its normalized masks be θU, so ψg,a,U = θUψg,a with the stated rescaling understood. Pull back the actual masks along QE. Then, as identities of smooth horizontal functions, X U ψZ g,a,U = ψZ g,a, X n<N ψZ g,2−n = (χ1 −χ2−N )QE.
